intro: Modeling builds stage presence, teamwork with crews and comfort on set. The closest of the 25 careers below is Makeup Artists, Theatrical and Performance, with a 74% skill match and a BLS May 2025 median of $97,150, which is 100% more than the $48,470 models earn.
why_it_works: Shoots and shows mean working with photographers, stylists and designers to a tight schedule. O*NET rates social perceptiveness at 2.88 out of 5 for models and coordination at 2.62. Makeup, costume, photography and fashion design roles share that production world. Some of these need a certificate or associate program. The skills to build are teaching, managing materials and checking quality.
tips: Use your industry contacts: ask stylists, makeup artists and photographers how they trained.
Fashion Designers earn $80,960, which is 67% more, and often start with an associate program.
Camera operators earn $74,990, or 55% more, if you are drawn to work behind the lens.

faq.q: What jobs can former models do?
faq.a: The closest matches are theatrical makeup artists (74%), Costume Attendants (71%) and Photographers (66%), based on O*NET 31.0. Costume Attendants earn $50,400, which is 4% more than the $48,470 model median, and usually need no extra training.

faq.q: Which careers for models pay more?
faq.a: 12 of the 25 matches pay more than modeling. Makeup artists earn $97,150 (100% more), Fashion Designers $80,960 (67% more) and television and film camera operators $74,990 (55% more), according to BLS May 2025 data. Talent Directors earn $90,360 for their broader group.

faq.q: Do models need a degree to change careers?
faq.a: Often some training. 15 of the 25 matches need no more education than models already have, but only 3 of the top 10. Many creative roles expect a certificate or associate degree. In the closest match, 33% of workers have a high school diploma as their highest level.

faq.q: What skills should models learn for a new career?
faq.a: The skills that most often need work are instructing, managing materials, operations analysis and quality control analysis. Time management already rates 2.5 out of 5 for models in O*NET, so learning a craft such as makeup, styling or camera work is the main step.
